findings.title: Unauthenticated Remote Desktop Protocol (NLA Disabled)
findings.description: Remote Desktop Protocol accepts incoming network connections without enforcing Network Level Authentication (NLA).
findings.risk_explanation: Adversaries on the local network can initiate pre-authentication RDP sessions, exposing the host to credential harvesting, denial of service, or remote code execution vulnerabilities.
findings.impact: Unrestricted exposure of RDP protocol stack to unauthenticated network traffic.
findings.recommendation: Enforce Network Level Authentication for all incoming Remote Desktop sessions.

findings.title: Local Security Authority Subsystem (LSASS) Unprotected
findings.description: LSASS process is not running as Protected Process Light (RunAsPPL).
findings.risk_explanation: Administrative processes or compromised service accounts can inject code into LSASS or read memory buffers to extract cached password hashes and Kerberos tickets.
findings.impact: Plaintext credential dumping and lateral movement via Mimikatz / Sekurlsa.
findings.recommendation: Enable RunAsPPL in LSA configuration to enforce kernel-level process protection.

findings.title: Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution (LLMNR) Enabled
findings.description: LLMNR allows the system to broadcast multicast queries across the local subnet when standard DNS resolution fails.
findings.risk_explanation: Adversaries running network poisoning tools (such as Responder) can respond to mistyped host queries and capture NTLMv2 challenge-response hashes.
findings.impact: Offline cracking of captured user credentials and lateral network movement.
findings.recommendation: Disable LLMNR via Group Policy across all network interfaces.

findings.title: SMBv1 Legacy Protocol Driver Active
findings.description: The legacy Server Message Block version 1 (SMBv1) protocol driver is installed and available on the system.
findings.risk_explanation: SMBv1 is vulnerable to remote code execution vulnerabilities (such as MS17-010 / EternalBlue) and lacks modern cryptographic message signing.
findings.impact: Remote unauthenticated kernel exploit exposure and ransomware propagation.
findings.recommendation: Completely remove the SMBv1 protocol driver package from the Windows installation.

findings.title: Process Creation Command-Line Auditing Disabled
findings.description: Process creation event logging (Event 4688) does not include execution command-line parameters in security event records.
findings.risk_explanation: Security operations teams cannot view full arguments passed to command interpreters (cmd.exe, powershell.exe, wmic.exe), hindering threat detection.
findings.impact: Forensic visibility gap during incident response and threat hunting operations.
findings.recommendation: Enable process command line auditing in System Audit policy.

findings.title: PowerShell Script Block Logging Disabled
findings.description: PowerShell Script Block Logging (Event ID 4104) is not enabled.
findings.risk_explanation: Adversaries using Base64-encoded download cradles and obfuscated scripts in memory can bypass standard logging without leaving script code traces.
findings.impact: Loss of execution telemetry for memory-resident fileless attacks.
findings.recommendation: Configure Script Block Logging via Group Policy to record all script block invocations.

findings.title: Defender Potentially Unwanted Application (PUA) Protection Disabled
findings.description: PUA protection is not enabled in Defender configuration.
findings.risk_explanation: Adware, coin miners, and commercial keyloggers bundled into software installers will not be blocked prior to installation.
findings.impact: Unwanted software execution and endpoint degradation.
findings.recommendation: Set PUA protection to Enabled in Defender settings.

findings.title: Account Lockout Threshold Not Configured
findings.description: The local account lockout threshold is set to 0 (unlimited failed logon attempts allowed).
findings.risk_explanation: Adversaries can perform continuous brute-force and password guessing attacks against local accounts without account suspension.
findings.impact: Unchecked password spray and dictionary attack exposure.
findings.recommendation: Configure the account lockout threshold to lock accounts after 5 consecutive invalid attempts.

findings.title: Unquoted Service Executable Path Detected
findings.description: The service executable path contains space characters and is not enclosed in double quotes.
findings.risk_explanation: Local unprivileged users with write access to C:\ or C:\Program Files can drop a malicious C:\Program.exe binary that executes with SYSTEM rights on service startup.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the binary path in quotation marks within the service registry ImagePath definition.

findings.title: Windows Firewall Public Profile Inbound Connection Action Set to Allow
findings.description: Default inbound action for the Public network profile is not configured to Block.
findings.risk_explanation: Connecting to untrusted or public Wi-Fi networks exposes unmanaged local listener ports to other clients on the subnet.
findings.recommendation: Configure Public firewall profile default inbound action to Block.

findings.title: Windows Defender Real-Time Scanning Active
findings.description: Real-time behavioral and file system monitoring is actively enforced.
findings.impact: Files and processes are scanned on execution.

findings.title: UEFI Secure Boot State Active
findings.description: Secure Boot is enabled and verifying digital signatures for all bootloader stages.
findings.impact: Protects against pre-OS bootkits and unauthorized kernel modules.
findings.recommendation: Maintain Secure Boot enabled in firmware.

remediation_plan.title: Enforce RDP Network Level Authentication (NLA)
remediation_plan.action: Configure RDP UserAuthentication to 1 in system registry.

remediation_plan.title: Enable LSA Protection (RunAsPPL)
remediation_plan.action: Set RunAsPPL to 1 in LSA registry hive.

remediation_plan.title: Disable LLMNR Name Resolution Broadcast
remediation_plan.action: Disable Multicast name resolution in DNSClient policy.

remediation_plan.title: Enable Process Creation Command-Line Auditing
remediation_plan.action: Enable ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine in System Audit policy.
